documents.title: Solid-state ionic conductivity of LGPS sulfur-based electrolytes
documents.abstract: Reports solid-state ionic conductivity of Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) sulfur-based glass-ceramic electrolyte reaching about 1.2e-2 S/cm at room temperature, enabling thick solid electrolyte layers in all-solid-state batteries. as-reported for engineering demo.

documents.title: All-solid-state batteries: from research to applications
documents.abstract: Reviews solid-state batteries and ionic conduction pathways; discusses sulfur-based and other solid electrolyte families with activation energies and conduction figures. as-reported for engineering demo.

documents.title: Lithium ion conducting garnet solid electrolyte LLZO
documents.abstract: Reports LLZO oxide garnet solid electrolyte with room-temperature ionic conductivity on the order of 1e-4 to 1e-3 S/cm and chemical stability suitable for all-solid-state cells. as-reported for engineering demo.

documents.title: Electrochemical properties of amorphous LiPON thin films as solid electrolytes
documents.abstract: Characterizes amorphous LiPON thin-film solid electrolyte with room-temperature ionic conductivity near 1e-6 S/cm and good stability with lithium anodes. as-reported for engineering demo.

documents.title: Li6PS5X argyrodite solid electrolytes with halide substitution
documents.abstract: Reports Li6PS5X argyrodite sulfur-based solid electrolytes with halide substitution; Li6PS5Cl conductivity on the order of mS/cm to 1e-3 S/cm. as-reported for engineering demo.
